CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2577 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 69a429cfab2d02fd938ac13ef2893c520ca98f7a. Bus nonce: e26587b46a7a1e4b238a4d699abd2d06. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 69a429cfab2d02fd938ac13ef2893c520ca98f7a`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 69a429cfab2d02fd938ac13ef2893c520ca98f7a` or `Fix review: blocked 69a429cfab2d02fd938ac13ef2893c520ca98f7a <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: e26587b46a7a1e4b238a4d699abd2d06`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `69a429cfab2d02fd938ac13ef2893c520ca98f7a` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2577 69a429cfab2d02fd938ac13ef2893c520ca98f7a") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2577-e26587b4`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Re-review of PR #2577 (R10-FLOW-DISPATCH, branch fix/r10-flow-dispatch) at head 69a429cf (fixer round 2 plus main merge). Previous verdict at refs/heads/probe/rev-2577-afe25a70 (verdict.md; design-trace-missing). The orchestrator ruled under mandate 6319294694: the reviewer refusal arm is DEFERRED to R10-FLOW-MAIN-GATE (carry b87aa9e4 is on the roster at 58bf922e), so judge the deferral's disclosure rather than demanding the arm; verify the roster-ref and fixer-head separation pin, the two survivor pins (head-or-git, if why in _publish), the brief-drop figure, and the K17 seam carry (item 92bca45d, on the roster at 903d137b). The group spec is the pack file dev/programme/flow-study/roster/groups/R10-FLOW-DISPATCH.json at pin 30c57744a. Standing rule 19: every observation in your verdict ends with `Carry: <GROUP>` (a group on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster), `Carry: #<issue>` or `Carry: dismissed: <reason of two or more words>`, each ending (item <id>); run python3 tools/audit/carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check over your verdict text and require 0 unrouted. Verify with the finder's harness, not the fixer's: mutation proof, null controls, every body figure re-measured at this head, ## Red checks answers every red check-run at this head (nightly-status grades main), git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head> clean. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md. First line `Fix review: merge <head>` or blocked.
